scope: Normal app process during real user acceptance testing and subsequent idle observation; no debugger attached. The final update changes only the primary click default and hover wording.
physical_verification: User confirmed mode menu, keyboard-only, trackpad-only, combined cleaning, external mouse and five-Esc recovery.
classification_note: Interaction pointer_filter_present reports pointer-mask presence only and does not identify keyboard-only activity. Post-use cleaning reports whether an enabled app-owned tap exists. Exact mode-specific CPU/RAM is not inferred.
